scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:electron && npm run typecheck:installer && npm run build:electron && vite build
scripts.pack:win: node ../../scripts/fetch-syncthing.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.pack:installer: npm run build:installer && electron-builder --win portable --publish never --config installer/electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.config.mjs
